description: This file contains a Bash script that performs data checks and upgrades for U-Boot-based embedded devices with specific partition configurations. It handles calculating image sizes, checksums, and updating environment variables related to firmware and root filesystem upgrades, particularly focusing on failsafe and dual-boot scenarios in embedded systems.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk
methods.description: Performs firmware data checks, calculates checksums, updates U-Boot environment variables, and manages the firmware upgrade process on embedded devices with failsafe and dual-boot configurations.
